snippet.title: Can you Escape Love?-Escape the Room Game [OFFICIAL TRAILER]
snippet.description:
NEW: Download game here for iOS FREE:https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/can-you-escape-love-escape/id1086408865?mt=8

Download the game here for Android FREE: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.jcsoft.canyouescapelovezodiac

Download the game here for iOS:COMING SOON

Also on DeviantArt:http://chibixi.deviantart.com/art/Can-You-Escape-Love-Inspired-by-Undertale-GAME-591646206

Can you fight and solve your way to freedom from an obsessed, love-struck sheep? 

Escape the Year of the Sheep using your puzzle solving skills! Heavily inspired by Undertale, Can you Escape Love : A Zodiac Story is a unique point and click style, escape the room survival game unlike any other!
Fight your way through boss battles and avoid getting hit using an intuitive touch drag control! Dodge obstacles and enemies! Play through an immersive storyline that will take you through a roller coaster of emotions and action adventure!

Set time back in motion and resume the Zodiac Cycle by fighting your way to the New Year!

FEATURES:
3 Different Endings! 
5+ Boss Battles
A Crazy Arcade Mode where you can fight to your heart's content
Many secrets to find! 
Endless fun!

From the creators of Animatronic Jumpscare Factory and Five Nights of Love, Can You Escape Love? is a new, addicting original survival escape the room game! 

Note: Look forward to new characters and more endings in future updates!
